watch.summary: The streamer carefully navigates a driving game finish line and celebrates excitedly upon beating the level.

beats.what: The streamer tensely talks himself through keeping the van straight.
He crosses the finish line with a top speed run.
He throws his arms up and yells in pure triumph.
